node.title: perlbrew: Command [ ... ] terminated with exit code 0 ($? = 13)
node.author: rsFalse
node.doctext:
Hello,
I'm getting this strange error warning when printing bigger output of 'perlbrew exec perl' into pipe to 'less -S':

$ perlbrew exec perl -wle 'print " A" x 1e3 for 1 .. 1e2' | less -S Command [perl -wle 'print " A" x 1e3 for 1 .. 1e2'] terminated with exit code 0 ($? = 13) under the following perl environment: Any ideas why it occurs?
P.S. I have two perls in perlbrew.
